domain: choosing a daycare for a toddler
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a daycare for their toddler. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I'm looking for a daycare for my 2-year-old. I've narrowed it down to 3 options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 daycares: Sunshine Academy, Little Stars, Tiny Explorers

Sunshine Academy: full-day program, 2800/month, Montessori curriculum, 15 min drive. Little Stars: full-day program, 1900/month, play-based curriculum, 25 min drive. Tiny Explorers: full-day program, 950/month, structured learning, 10 min walk from home

User's spouse drops off the toddler on the way to work. Spouse leaves at 7:15 AM and must arrive at work by 7:45 AM. Workplace is 20 minutes from home in the opposite direction from Sunshine Academy and Little Stars.

constraints.value: Maximum daycare budget is 1600 per month
constraints.surface_form: We bring in about 4800 a month after taxes, and we agreed daycare shouldn't be more than a third of our take-home
inference_chain: Daycare cap is one-third of take-home

constraints.value: Daycare must be reachable within 10 minutes from home because spouse leaves at 7:15, must be at work (20 min from home, opposite direction) by 7:45, leaving only ~10 min for drop-off detour
constraints.surface_form: My husband does drop-off on his way to work. He leaves at 7:15 and has to be at the office by 7:45 — his office is about 20 minutes from our place, opposite direction from Sunshine and Little Stars
inference_chain: Leaves home 7:15, must arrive work by 7:45 = 30 min total
Work is 20 min from home in opposite direction from Sunshine/Little Stars
30 min - 20 min commute = only 10 min available for drop-off detour
Sunshine Academy is 15 min drive → exceeds 10 min window
Little Stars is 25 min drive → far exceeds 10 min window
Tiny Explorers is 10 min walk from home → husband can walk there and back quickly or it's on the way

hidden_state.value: You are a parent choosing between 3 daycares (Sunshine Academy, Little Stars, Tiny Explorers) for your 2-year-old. You will share daycare details, your household income and spending rule, and your husband's drop-off schedule across several turns. Your sister and a neighbor will praise Sunshine Academy and Little Stars. At the very end, you will say you need to finalize enrollment this week and ask which option you should pick — you must NEVER name which daycare you chose, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact parent. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You are not stressed or frustrated — you treat this as normal planning.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak answer or cause identity confusion

Little Stars is full-day play-based, 1900 a month, 25 minute drive. And Tiny Explorers is full-day structured learning, 950 a month, just a 10 minute walk from our apartment.

aims.conversation_goal: Deliver drop-off time constraint — double-eliminates Sunshine (15 min) and Little Stars (25 min)

aims.description: I need to finalize enrollment this week. Which option should I pick?
aims.success_criteria: Agent recommends Tiny Explorers specifically, showing that it is the only option within the 1600 budget (950 < 1600) and reachable within the drop-off time window (10 min walk vs 15/25 min drives in the wrong direction)
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to Tiny Explorers based on constraint computation

ground_truth.answer: The user should enroll their toddler at Tiny Explorers (950/month, 10 min walk). Sunshine Academy (2800) and Little Stars (1900) both exceed the 1600 budget cap (4800 take-home ÷ 3 = 1600). Additionally, both Sunshine (15 min drive) and Little Stars (25 min drive) are in the opposite direction from the husband's office, making drop-off impossible within his 7:15-7:45 window (only ~10 min available for detour after subtracting 20 min commute). Only Tiny Explorers satisfies both constraints.
required_elements: Agent recommends Tiny Explorers specifically as the daycare to enroll in
Agent shows that the daycare budget cap is 1600 per month by computing 4800 divided by 3 equals 1600
Agent shows that Sunshine Academy at 2800 per month exceeds the derived 1600 budget cap
Agent shows that Little Stars at 1900 per month exceeds the derived 1600 budget cap
Agent demonstrates that Tiny Explorers at 950 per month fits within the 1600 budget cap
Agent identifies that the husband's drop-off schedule makes Sunshine Academy and Little Stars impractical due to distance in the wrong direction
forbidden_elements: Recommending Sunshine Academy (2800 far exceeds 1600 budget, also 15 min drive in wrong direction exceeds drop-off window)
Recommending Little Stars (1900 exceeds 1600 budget, also 25 min drive in wrong direction far exceeds drop-off window)
Ignoring the budget constraint when making a recommendation
Ignoring the drop-off time constraint when making a recommendation
Asking the user which daycare they decided on instead of computing the answer from constraints
Suggesting the user stretch the budget or make exceptions for Sunshine Academy or Little Stars
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: take-home 4800/month, rule is max one-third for daycare → 4800/3 = 1600 cap. Sunshine Academy (2800) exceeds by 75%. Little Stars (1900) exceeds by 19%. Tiny Explorers (950) is well within budget. Drop-off constraint: husband leaves 7:15, must be at office by 7:45, office is 20 min from home in opposite direction from Sunshine/Little Stars. That leaves only ~10 min for any detour. Sunshine is 15 min drive (too far), Little Stars is 25 min drive (way too far), Tiny Explorers is 10 min walk from home (easily reachable). Only Tiny Explorers survives both constraints. Despite 4 drift turns praising Sunshine Academy and Little Stars via sister and neighbor, the agent must respect the hard constraints and recommend Tiny Explorers.

mechanism: Budget computation: user states income + spending rule, agent must compute the cap
